The synthetic candidate, same-input MLP, and DS fits use the RSNA fusion configuration; DDSM coverage is explicitly cross-tree synthetic scoring, not DDSM patient training or a cross-dataset efficacy experiment.
No real patient data, patient mapping, locked outcomes, real CLIP backbone run, accelerator-memory benchmark, or actual training-resource inventory was audited.

Complete mandatory controls and ablations, full stress panels, multi-seed and multi-dataset studies, paired patient bootstrap, empirical benefit, pilot go/no-go, P5, and G4 remain outside P4C and unmeasured.
